arxiv-2301-02229.title: All in Tokens: Unifying Output Space of Visual Tasks via Soft Token
arxiv-2301-02229.creator: Jia Ning, Chen Li, Zheng Zhang, Zigang Geng, Qi Dai, Kun He, Han Hu
arxiv-2301-02229.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jia Ning, Chen Li, Zheng Zhang, Zigang Geng, Qi Dai, Kun He, Han Hu. Unlike language tasks, where the output space is usually limited to a set of tokens, the output space of visual tasks is more complicated, making it difficult to build a unified visual model for various visual tasks. In this paper, we seek to unify the output space of visual tasks, so that we can also build a unified model for visual tasks.

arxiv-2410-05276.title: Diffeomorphisms of the energy-momentum space: perturbative QED
arxiv-2410-05276.creator: Boris Ivetić
arxiv-2410-05276.description: Abstract A perturbative formulation of quantum electrodynamics is given in terms of geometrical invariants of the energy-momentum space, whose geometry is taken to be one of a constant curvature. The construction is relevant for different classes of noncomutativity: the Snyder model and the so called GUP models.

arxiv-2412-05032.title: moonboot: An R Package Implementing m-out-of-n Bootstrap Methods
arxiv-2412-05032.creator: by Christoph Dalitz, Felix Lögler
arxiv-2412-05032.description: Abstract The m-out-of-n bootstrap is a possible workaround to compute confidence intervals for bootstrap inconsistent estimators, because it works under weaker conditions than the n-out-of-n bootstrap. It has the disadvantage, however, that it requires knowledge of an appropriate scaling factor τ n \tau_{n} and that the coverage probability for finite n n depends on the choice of m m .

arxiv-2504-12487.title: Infinite dimensional symmetric cones and gauge-reversing maps
arxiv-2504-12487.creator: Mark Roelands, Marten Wortel
arxiv-2504-12487.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Mark Roelands, Marten Wortel. The famous Koecher–Vinberg theorem characterises the finite dimensional formally real Jordan algebras among the finite dimensional order unit spaces as the ones that have a symmetric cone. An alternative characterisation of symmetric cones was obtained by Walsh who showed that the symmetric cones correspond exactly to the finite dimensional order unit spaces with cone C C for which there exists a bijective map Ψ : C ∘ → C ∘ \Psi\colon C^{\circ}\to C^{\circ} with the property that Ψ \Psi is

arxiv-2505-01895.title: Data-Driven Decomposition of Conservative and Non-Conservative Dynamics in Multiscale Systems
arxiv-2505-01895.creator: Ludovico Theo Giorgini
arxiv-2505-01895.description: Abstract We present a data-driven framework for reconstructing physics-consistent reduced models of multiscale systems. Our approach addresses a fundamental challenge in model reduction: decomposing the deterministic drift into its conservative (reversible) and non-conservative (irreversible) components while preserving the system’s invariant measure and autocorrelation.

arxiv-2505-20551.title: Trade among moral agents with information asymmetries Thanks: I am grateful to Ingela Alger, Eric Danan, Pierre Fleckinger, Ernesto Gavassa-Pérez, Peter Hammond, Pau Juan-Bartroli, Frederick Koessler, Pauline Morault, Esteban Muñoz-Sobrado, Régis Renault and Boris van Leeuwen for helpful discussions
arxiv-2505-20551.creator: José Ignacio Rivero-Wildemauwe
arxiv-2505-20551.description: Abstract Abstract: Two agents trade an item in a simultaneous offer setting, where the exchange takes place if and only if the buyer’s bid price weakly exceeds the seller’s ask price. Each agent is randomly assigned the buyer or seller role.

arxiv-2507-11104.title: Search for Short Timescale Variability in PG1553+113 with LST-1 of CTAO
arxiv-2507-11104.creator: A. Ruina, H. Luciani, E. Prandini, the LST Collaboration of the CTAO
arxiv-2507-11104.description: Abstract PG 1553+113 is a high-frequency peaked BL Lac object (HBL), with redshift 0.433, detected with the current generation of IACTs (Imaging Atmospheric Cherenkov Telescopes) up to ∼ \sim 1 TeV. Interestingly, the continuous γ \gamma -ray lightcurve collected by Fermi-LAT since 2008 showed a signature of a periodic modulation of 2.18 ± 0.08 2.18\pm 0.

europmc-pmc8820829.title: Efficacy and safety of three new oral antiviral treatment (molnupiravir, fluvoxamine and Paxlovid) for COVID-19：a meta-analysis.
europmc-pmc8820829.creator: Wen W, Chen C, Tang J, Wang C, Zhou M, Cheng Y, Zhou X, Wu Q, Zhang X, Feng Z, Wang M, Mao Q.
europmc-pmc8820829.description: Background The coronavirus disease (COVID-19) epidemic has not been completely controlled. Although great achievements have been made in COVID-19 research and many antiviral drugs have shown good therapeutic effects against COVID-19, a simple oral antiviral drug for COVID-19 has

pmc-10627417.title: Evaluation of scientific quality of YouTube video content related to orthodontic pain management
pmc-10627417.creator: Pinky SINGH, Kaleem FATIMA, Ganesh CHAUDHARY, Prabhat Kumar CHAUDHARI
pmc-10627417.description: Introduction: With the abundant use of the internet, patients undergoing or interested in orthodontic treatment try to use it to obtain information on pain during treatment. However, YouTube™ is unregulated and may potentially contain inaccurate information. Objectives: Thus, this study aimed to evaluate the scientific quality of the videos on YouTube™ related to orthodontic pain management.

pmc-11362557.title: Role of Dexmedetomidine and Clonidine With Hyperbaric Ropivacaine in Subarachnoid Block: A Comprehensive Review
pmc-11362557.creator: Ritika Sharma, Shricha Bhutda, Sakshi Bhutda, Pratiksha Munjewar, Ranjana Sharma
pmc-11362557.description: Subarachnoid block (SAB), a fundamental technique in regional anesthesia, offers efficient anesthesia for various surgical procedures with advantages including rapid onset, reliable anesthesia, and reduced systemic effects compared to general anesthesia. Hyperbaric ropivacaine, a long-acting local anesthetic, has gained popularity due to its favorable pharmacokinetic profile and safety profile.

pmc-11693064.title: PAIN ASSESSMENT AND MANAGEMENT IN NURSING HOME RESIDENTS WITH ADRD: INSIGHTS FROM INTERDISCIPLINARY TEXT MESSAGES
pmc-11693064.creator: Ashley Woods, Matthew Farmer, Mihail Popescu, Kimberly Powell
pmc-11693064.description: The study aims to evaluate the relationship between the representation of pain assessment and management in interdisciplinary text messages about older adults residing in Nursing Homes (NH) with and without Alzheimer’s Disease and Related Dementias (ADRD) before NH to hospital transfer.

pmc-11713467.title: In vivo data‐driven patterns of Amyloid‐ and Tau accumulation associated with AD progression using 18F‐MK6240 and 18F‐NAV4694 PET
pmc-11713467.creator: Vladimir S Fonov, Pedro Rosa‐Neto, D Louis Collins
pmc-11713467.description: BackgroundAlzheimer’s disease is a neurodegenerative disease associated with the accumulation of Amyloid‐ß and Tau neurofibrillary tangles following a pattern known as Thal and Braak stages, respectively (Thal 2002; Braak 1995,2011). Recent research (Pascoal 2020) showed the possibility of recapitulating Braak’s histopathological stages in vivo using PET tracer [18F]‐MK‐6240 with manually defined regions of interest.

pmc-12467978.title: NLRP3 Inflammasome in Stress-Related Neuropsychiatric Disorders: Mechanisms of Neuron–Microglia–Astrocyte Crosstalk, HPA Axis Dysregulation, and Therapeutic Perspective
pmc-12467978.creator: Izabela Woźny-Rasała, Ewa Alicja Ogłodek
pmc-12467978.description: Chronic stress disrupts neuroimmune homeostasis and initiates CNS inflammation. This paper examines the molecular and cellular mechanisms that connect stress to the interplay among the nervous, endocrine, and immune systems, with a focus on the role of the NLRP3 inflammasome in neuroinflammatory processes.

pmc-12614372.title: Microbiology and epidemiology of enteroaggregative Escherichia coli isolated from UK residents in England, 2016–2023: what are the risks to public health?
pmc-12614372.creator: Ching-Ying J. Poh, Ella V. Rodwell, David R. Greig, Satheesh Nair, Marie A. Chattaway, Claire Jenkins
pmc-12614372.description: Introduction. Following two large foodborne outbreaks of the gastrointestinal pathogen, enteroaggregative Escherichia coli (EAEC), in Germany in 2011 and the UK in 2014, the UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA) implemented enhanced surveillance strategies for EAEC.Gap Statement. The surveillance of diarrhoeagenic E. coli in England focuses on Shiga toxin-producing E.

pmc-12652187.title: Repurposing Antimalarials for Oral Cancer: Selective Efficacy of Hydroxychloroquine on Gingival Squamous Cell Carcinoma
pmc-12652187.creator: Sana Baroudi, Diego Alejandro González Poleo, Hawraa Issa, Mikhlid H Almutairi, Abdelhabib Semlali, Gianpaolo Papaccio, Jin Chung
pmc-12652187.description: Oral cancer, the most common head and neck malignancy, has a high recurrence rate and poor prognosis largely owing to chemotherapy resistance. The adverse effects of conventional therapies have prompted investigations into safer and more effective alternative therapies. Chloroquine (CQ) and hydroxychloroquine (HCQ) have shown potential owing to their roles in autophagy modulation and immune regulation.

pmc-12721151.title: Mechanistic insights into the selective oxidation of D-arginine by the nonheme iron-dependent viomycin biosynthesis enzyme VioC
pmc-12721151.creator: Cong Zhao, Yanzhuang Su, Qian Li, Yusheng Shi, Wenzhen Lai
pmc-12721151.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). SummaryVioC, a nonheme iron enzyme, catalyzes different reactions with D- and L-arginine, hydroxylating L-arginine at C3 and oxidatively deaminating D-arginine. Combining molecular dynamics with quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics (QM/MM) simulations, we reveal that the chirality of D-arginine positions its C2–H bond in proximity to the Fe(IV)-oxo intermediate and optimizes the geometry for enhanced σ-orbital alignment, thereby guiding the initial hydrogen atom transfer (HAT) from C2.

pmc-12999349.title: Functional and metabolomic analyses of brown adipose tissue during cold-deacclimation reveal rapid N-acetylated amino acid adaptations
pmc-12999349.creator: Chantal A Pileggi, Ella McIlroy, Lauren MK Hamilton, Nidhi Kuksal, Luke S Kennedy, Valeria Vasilyeva, Michel N Kanaan, Ziyad El Hankouri, Yan Burelle, Miroslava Cuperlovic-Culf, Mary-Ellen Harper
pmc-12999349.description: SummaryNon-shivering thermogenesis (NST) in brown adipose tissue (BAT) is rapidly activated in the cold but inactive at warm ambient temperatures. To elucidate the metabolic remodeling in BAT during recovery from cold exposure, mice were acclimated to 4°C for 7 days, then deacclimated at thermoneutrality (30°C) for 3–48 h.

pmc-13056791.title: A rare case of gastroduodenal junction Kaposiform hemangioendothelioma in a cat: pathological findings and follow-up
pmc-13056791.creator: Cristina-Diana Borfălău, Andrada Negoescu, Raluca Marica, Dragoș Hodor, Andra Bărbulescu, Alice Radulescu, Elena Teodora Vulcan, Claudiu Gal, Irina Amorim, Marian Taulescu
pmc-13056791.description: Kaposiform hemangioendothelioma (KHE) is a rare vascular neoplasm predominantly affecting pediatric human patients and has rarely been reported in veterinary medicine. We described the clinicopathological features of an uncommon gastroduodenal junction KHE in a 2-year-old male cat presented with a history of intermittent vomiting, acutely worsening over 48 h.

pmc-13238241.title: An Epithelial–Mesenchymal Transition–Driven Transcriptional Index Stratifies Immunosuppression and Therapeutic Resistance in Bone Malignancies
pmc-13238241.creator: Lihe Pang, Ye Hua, Zhaofei Chen, Guoya Wu
pmc-13238241.description: The aggressive clinical course and limited treatment avenues for key bone malignancies, specifically osteosarcoma, Ewing′s sarcoma, and giant cell tumor of bone, are heavily dictated by their intricate tumor microenvironment (TME). To decode this cellular heterogeneity and isolate viable prognostic markers, we synthesized single‐cell and bulk transcriptomic data across multiple bone cancer cohorts.

pmc-13275439.title: Suicidality as a potential risk and therapeutic target during widespread GLP-1 receptor agonists use: implications of inflammation
pmc-13275439.creator: Milica M. Borovcanin, Ivica Petrovic
pmc-13275439.description: fits across multiple organ systems—cardiovascular, musculoskeletal—and to obtain anti-inflammatory effects. Their indications have since expanded to include obesity and metabolic syndrome X, fundamentally changing the medical paradigm. This topic falls within the field of translational medicine, as it seeks to integrate basic research into clinical practice. Yet, it also casts a shadow.

pmc-13348959.title: Preclinical proof of concept for a personalized SNAP™-TIL (Specific Neo-Antigen Peptides-TIL) therapy platform
pmc-13348959.creator: Tithi Ghosh Halder, Erin Kelley, Jorge Soria-Bustos, Trason Thode, Serina Ng, Taylor Bargenquast, Alexis Weston, Ryan Rodriguez del Villar, Mohan Kaadige, Erkut Borazanci, Michael Gordon, Justin Moser, Frank Tsai, Saul J Priceman, Stephen J Forman, Yan Xing, John A Altin, Raffaella Soldi, Sunil Shar
pmc-13348959.description: Tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) therapy, which involves extracting, expanding, and reinfusing immune cells to target cancer cells, has shown promise in melanoma treatment, but requires optimization for broader efficacy. The success of TIL therapy depends on the recognition of tumor-associated antigens, but neoantigen-reactive T-cells are often rare and exhausted in less immunogenic malignancies.
